status: started 2026-09-27 by the test author at the owner's request, after the swim-fatigue rule broke the Dive rung and nothing caught it; reviewed by humans, enforced by tests/test_system_contracts.py
rule: A contract is one system's guarantee that another system relies on. A change to any system's rule runs `python -m pytest tests/test_system_contracts.py`; a new assumption one system makes about another gets a contract here and a test there (.claude/rules/testing.md 'Cross-system contracts').

fields.owner: the system whose data or code provides the guarantee
fields.consumers: the systems that rely on it; at least one differs from the owner
fields.constrained_by: systems that do not rely on the guarantee but can break it with a change of their own
fields.stated_in: where the guarantee is written: path:line and a quote the line must still contain
fields.tests: the tests that enforce it (path::function); tests in tests/test_system_contracts.py are named test_contract_*
fields.fails_today: cases (pytest ids, fnmatch patterns) that fail on the recorded commit, each with its reason; the tests mark them strict xfail, so a fix makes the run fail until the entry is removed

water_ladder.what: Surf and Dive air at depth: the ladder's qualification, the Surf bonus, Dive's unlimited air, the half-health pulses

swim_fatigue.what: surface exhaustion: fatigue for every swim, its rates, thresholds and collapse hits

water_sites.what: every lake floor, wreck and Dive site sized on the ladder's rungs

ferry.what: the ferry lines and which of them are gates

terrain.what: the canonical heightmap and the ground laid over it (the islet, the sea town's decks)

world_block_packs.what: every generator that writes blocks into the world, through its allowed or named block list

wild_spawns.what: what spawns where: the loaded spawn conditions and the policy of which placed blocks may decide them

recovery_claims.what: the blackout's item claims and their guardians

reexport.what: the re-export: carrying players and world state into a fresh export, and re-applying every build

rift_mine_gate.what: the Rift mine's company gate, its ward and its zone check

progression.what: the per-player progression flags (advancements) and the waystones they unlock

blackout_checkpoints.what: where a blacked-out player returns: Centers and town waystones

towns.what: the placed towns and their Pokemon Centers

contracts.title: Dive is unlimited underwater
contracts.statement: A Dive-trained player with a Dive-capable Pokemon in the party, eyes at the ladder's depth, can stay under water for at least ten minutes without being hurt or knocked out by any system: the air ladder and swim fatigue together.

stated_in.quote: An unlocked Dive ability plus a qualifying Pokemon gives unlimited
Keep air full while submerged
| **Dive** (training after gym 6, with a Dive-capable Pokemon) | unlimited |
new rule is **knocked out at 33 s**

cases.*: swim fatigue builds under water for a trained player (data/blackout.json surface.rule counts the eyes at the ladder's depth as deep water, and a trained partner only halves it): a Dive player at depth is hit at 30 s and knocked out at 33 s (WATER_BUILD_PLAN.md finding F1). Being fixed in the main session: trained players will not tire under water

contracts.title: Surf gives its whole bonus at depth, and nothing hurts a Surf player sooner than the ladder does
contracts.statement: A Surf-trained player with a Surf-capable Pokemon in the party, at depth, has air held full for surf_bonus_ticks per submersion, then vanilla's 300 ticks, before any hit; no other system hurts or knocks them out sooner than the ladder alone does.

stated_in.quote: 10. An unlocked Surf ability plus a qualifying Pokemon in the active party gives
Hold vanilla air full for 900 bonus ticks, then allow the normal 300 ticks: about 60 seconds total
45 s held full, then vanilla 15 s, then the same two hits: about 61 s

cases.fresh-*: a player who has never blacked out gets no Surf bonus at all: bo.surf is set only by blackout/arrive (tools/blackout_pack.py:287), water/deep tests `if score @s bo.surf < #surf bo.cfg` (line 774), and vanilla fails a comparison on an unset score, so the bonus never starts; the ladder alone hits at 301 ticks, not 1200 (found by this contract; tests/test_blackout_pack.py's _deep_ticks sets bo.surf 0 first, which hides it)
cases.blacked-out-*: swim fatigue hits a Surf player at depth at 30 s, before surf_bonus_ticks + 300 (60 s) run out (the incident, WATER_BUILD_PLAN.md finding F1)

contracts.title: No world pack places a spawn condition its place is not whitelisted for
contracts.statement: Every block a generator's allowed or named list holds (and every block an earthwork places) is either named by no loaded spawn condition, or allowed by a data/spawn_block_policy.json entry whose scope names that place.

stated_in.quote: Spawn-neutral by default.
A template that contains one decides encounters wherever it is placed

tools.rift_mines_audit.py: checker: the built rift_mines pack (source rift_mines)
tools.route1_old_mine.py: source: earthworks (its record is the route1_old_mine earthwork in data/placements.json)
tools.town_audit.py: checker: the built towns, templates and earthworks, against the policy
tools.validate_data.py: checker: placed structure templates, against the policy
tools.town_templates.py: checker: spawn blocks in template candidates (through tools/spawn_blocks.py)
tools.spawn_blocks.py: not covered: it writes data/spawn_blocks.json (the scan of loaded spawn conditions)
tools.paint_maps.py: not covered: WorldPainter plant sets, painted at export, not a datapack

cases.earthworks:route1_mansion: the mansion's earthwork route1_mansion_house places minecraft:light_gray_wool (tools/route1_mansion.py:123, the foyer's dust-sheeted chairs; data/placements.json), a spawn condition for smeargle and herds (neededNearbyBlocks), and no policy entry is scoped to the mansion. The tool's docstring (line 33) says no block in it is a spawn condition; furnish() (line 99) leans on the ward stone's ReplaceSpawns instead

contracts.title: Open claims survive a re-export
contracts.statement: All claim state lives in the ledger storage (cobblers_recovery:ledger) and the scoreboard, both of which tools/carry_players.py carries and nothing else of which it needs; a claim made before a re-export is rebuilt from the ledger in the new world and pays its owner when its guardian is beaten.

stated_in.quote: include the recovery store in the explicit re-export
the blackout claim ledger (tools/blackout_pack.py): open item claims are owed to players
which tools/carry_players.py carries into a re-exported world

contracts.title: A gate's ward keeps its plug out of reach
contracts.statement: For every gate in the data (an object with a plug and a ward_margin), a survival player whose feet are outside the generated ward cannot reach any block of the plug or the grille: 4.5 blocks from eyes 1.62 above the feet.

stated_in.quote: so the gate cannot be dug round or broken

contracts.title: The re-apply covers every generated pack
contracts.statement: Every generated pack that ships functions is run by a re-apply step or is in tools/reapply.py EXCLUDED with its reason; prepare fails closed otherwise, so no build is silently lost at a re-export.

stated_in.quote: Anything not here and not run
Fail closed instead.

contracts.title: A gate opens on a flag the progression pack grants
contracts.statement: Every advancement the Rift mine's generated gate tests is one tools/progression_pack.py writes, granted by a real trigger (not minecraft:impossible), and it is the badge the gate's message names.

stated_in.quote: The flag is the advancement tools/progression_pack.py writes for each leader

contracts.title: Swim fatigue reads this tick's water-ladder state
contracts.statement: surface/tick reads bo.sub, bo.deep and bo.qual as water/tick sets them in the same tick for the same players, and a collapse hits with the ladder's own half-health pulse.

stated_in.quote: or the eyes at the water ladder's depth
a player the water ladder qualifies

contracts.title: Every Center and town waystone is a blackout checkpoint
contracts.statement: Every Pokemon Center in data/placements.json and every town waystone in data/progression.json has a fixed checkpoint id; the blackout pack refuses to build otherwise.

stated_in.quote: The player returns to the last Pokemon Center they successfully used
